events.title: S&P Futures Tick Higher as Oil Prices and Bond Yields Fall, U.S. ADP Jobs Report and Broadcom Earnings on Tap
events.summary: S&P 500 E-Mini futures are up after three days of losses, driven by a retreat in oil prices and bond yields despite intensifying U.S.-Iran conflict. Investors are anticipating the U.S. ADP employment report and quarterly results from Broadcom, as previous economic data indicated a healthy but slowing U.S. economy. Dell Technologies surged on strong Q2 results and an upbeat sales outlook, while other chip and AI-related stocks faced pressure from elevated bond yields.

events.title: Onto Innovation (ONTO) Unveiled Dragonfly G5 At SEMICON Taiwan 2026
events.summary: Onto Innovation showcased its new Dragonfly G5 system at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, targeting advanced node logic and memory applications to improve defect inspection and yield for semiconductor manufacturers. The company emphasized how its process control solutions address challenges in high-volume chip production for AI and data centers. Investors are advised to watch for order and backlog growth related to Dragonfly G5 and advanced packaging tools in upcoming reports.

events.title: Jim Cramer Says This Tech Stock Is Up 40% For The Year: It Is A ‘Great’ Company
events.summary: Jim Cramer highlighted KLA Corporation (NASDAQ: KLAC) as a "great" company with a 40% year-to-date gain, despite a high price-to-earnings multiple. He also discussed Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT), Velo3D (NASDAQ: VELO), and General Dynamics (NYSE: GD), recommending Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) as his top pick in the defense sector. The article also provides recent stock performances for these companies.

events.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Q3 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
events.summary: Lam Research reported strong Q3 2025 earnings, surpassing revenue and EPS estimates due to increased demand for deposition and etch equipment. The company saw a significant year-over-year revenue increase and provided an optimistic outlook for the June quarter, signaling continued growth despite tariff uncertainties. These results reflect strong performance across key geographies and expanding gross margins.

events.title: Applied Materials Just Dropped 14% in a Month. Sell Now, or Buy More?
events.summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) stock has dropped 14% in the past month despite reporting record revenue and raising guidance, while its peers have seen minimal declines. This selloff is attributed to profit-taking after a 178% surge over the past year, indicating that strong execution was already priced into the stock. Investors are now faced with deciding whether to sell or buy more, with the burden of proof resting on buyers until the next earnings report.

events.title: Applied Materials’ stock buybacks: History & investor impact explained
events.summary: Applied Materials, a leading manufacturer of semiconductor equipment, has a long history of stock buybacks dating back to 1996, totaling nearly $50 billion. The company's buyback activity, often exceeding its free cash flow, demonstrates an aggressive approach to returning value to shareholders, particularly in recent years amidst rising interest in AI. Despite a record stock high in June 2026, the company reduced repurchases in fiscal 2026.
